# cloudaxion_block_volume (Resource)

A block storage volume, independent of any virtual machine.

Attach it with `cloudaxion_volume_attachment`. Keeping the volume and the attachment separate means data can outlive the VM that used it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudaxion_block_volume" "data" {
  name    = "etcd-data"
  size_gb = 50
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the volume.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size in gigabytes. **Changing this replaces the volume and destroys its data** — this endpoint has no in-place resize.

### Optional

- `billing_account_id` (Number) Billing account. Defaults to the provider's `billing_account_id`.
- `location` (String) Location slug. Defaults to the provider's `location`.
- `read_only_bootable` (Boolean) Whether the volume is exposed as read-only bootable media.
- `source_image` (String) Image, disk or snapshot to clone, when `source_type` is not `EMPTY`.
- `source_type` (String) What to seed the volume from: `EMPTY` (the default), `OS_BASE`, `DISK` or `SNAPSHOT`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp reported by the API.
- `id` (String) Volume UUID.
- `status` (String) Volume status reported by the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cloudaxion_block_volume.data tun01/18286314-4792-40f0-afe2-b2c05d21e159
```
